title: Operation Order
description: Evaluate arithmetic expressions with unusual operator precedence rules.
writeup:
## Approach

Build a recursive descent parser that respects the specified precedence rules. Tokenize each expression into numbers, operators, and parentheses.

## Part 1

`+` and `*` have equal precedence, evaluated left to right. The parser has two levels: `parse_atom` handles numbers and parenthesized sub-expressions, and `parse_expr` applies operators left to right.

## Part 2

`+` has higher precedence than `*`. The parser adds a third level: `parse_atom` (numbers/parens), `parse_add` (chains of `+`), and `parse_mul` (chains of `*`). This naturally makes `+` bind tighter, since it's resolved at a deeper level of the parse tree.
